What if your AI agent could retouch your photos?
AgentPhoto is the photo studio your AI agent can run.
Every edit is a layer you can change later,
the agent looks at its own renders,
and the editing and the AI run on your computer.
A real Claude Code session. One sentence: make my trip photo look great.
The agent measures the photo, fixes light and colour, adds a film look, and compares before and after.
Then it exports a square post and a link preview.
Before and after, from one sentence.
Next, a product photo for a shop.
A local AI model removes the background. Nothing is uploaded.
Clean, on white, with a soft shadow.
Or a YouTube thumbnail from a template, with a title you can read on a phone.
Agents start from templates and recipes:
thumbnails, link previews, stories and sale banners,
packshots on white, portraits, and film looks.
When you want to finish by hand, open the Studio.
Pick a look, check the filters, move the title,
and export at the size you need.
One engine, four front doors: the Studio, its assistant, the CLI and an MCP server.
Renders run headless in your own Chrome, so the agent sees its work.
PNG, JPEG or WebP, at every social size, in one command.
Transparent cut-outs, and light files for the web.
No server, no account, no upload.
AgentPhoto. The photo studio your AI agent can run.
Install the Claude Code plugin, or run it with npx.
